Smart SEL-32G25F 32" FHD Voice Control Android Smart Google TV

The Smart SEL-32G25F Android Smart Google TV boasts a 32-inch BOE panel with Full HD resolution of 1920 x 1080, ensuring clear details, rich colors, and a smooth 60Hz refresh rate for everyday viewing. The Smart SEL-32G25F 32" FHD Smart TV has a brightness rating of 180±10% nits and 176-degree horizontal and vertical viewing angles, ensuring constant picture quality from any seat in the room. The Smart SEL-32G25F Smart Google TV, which runs Android 13, provides personalized content recommendations based on your tastes, making entertainment discovery simple and exciting. Built-in voice control with Google Assistant enables hands-free navigation, quick searches, and even smart home control, increasing ease in everyday use. With several HDMI connectors, USB ports, AV input, Ethernet compatibility, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth, you can easily connect to gaming consoles, sound systems, and external storage devices. The Smart SEL-32G25F 32" FHD Google TV boasts dual 10W stereo speakers powered by Dolby Audio MS12/AC-4 and Dolby Atmos, resulting in a cinema-like soundstage that enriches movies, shows, and music. Power efficiency is carefully balanced, with 75W consumed during FHD use and standby power usage at under 0.5W. With dependable performance, smart functionality, and a stylish style, the Smart SEL-32G25F 32" FHD Android Smart Google TV is an excellent choice for bedrooms, living rooms, or flats. Whether streaming, browsing, or gaming, this Smart Google TV provides a seamless, user-friendly, and connected entertainment experience.
